card.name: Weekly Digest Card
card.author: Jiahui Miao
card.description: Sits next to a post in the feed. Tap it and it reads the thread, drafts a weekly digest from it, and prepares a share - which it cannot send until a human approves.

feed.read_thread.description: Read the post and its replies the card is attached to.

digest.draft.description: Compose the digest locally; nothing leaves the system.

feed.share.description: Post the digest back to the feed. This is a send: blocked until a human approves.
